content:
At the age of 28, I've visited all 25 High Courts, the Supreme Court, Tribunals, Commissions and various forums across India.⚖️♥️

From unreserved train journeys to business-class flights. From railway dormitories to business-class hotel rooms.

Everything changed the lifestyle, the opportunities, the experiences.

But the hunger never changed.

I'm proud of how far I've come, but I refuse to settle here.

Every setback taught me something. Every struggle made me stronger. Every milestone only made me dream bigger.

The goal is not just to travel farther. It is to become better.

Now, the next chapter begins upgrading my skills, expanding my horizons and taking my journey beyond India.

One day, Singapore. International Arbitration. A bigger arena.

I've come a long way

But I'm nowhere near done.⚖️✨🐾♥️🍃🪽
